address: 2270 Qiongling Road, Wuzhong, Suzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: A must for lamb lovers, this restaurant has been around for over two decades. From cold appetizers and soups to stir-fries and starch, every course will satisfy your craving for lamb. Generously covered in cumin, grilled lamb’s leg comes in the perfect portion size for the solo diner with firm, flavoursome flesh. Mung bean soup with mint, sticky rice, red beans and candied winter melon will end your meal with a flourish.
